newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Gov George Pataki signs ballot reform bill.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Gov George Pataki signs ballot reform bill.

text.p: New York Gov. George Pataki on Tuesday said he signed a bill to reform the state's election law, making it easier to put individuals who are running for public office in local, state and federal races on the ballot.

"This new law will help build confidence in our democracy by putting an end to unproductive technicalities that too often are used as weapons to bounce candidates from the ballot," Pataki said, in prepared remarks.

New York State has some of the nation's most stringent ballot rules, which have imposed substantial burdens on potential candidates and the governor promised this new law, which he proposed in June, was only a first step.
Pataki said he will offer legislation to improve ballot access for the Republican Party presidential primary after more talks with party leaders.
